skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Shaved-Ice Memories
skins.content: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/Shaved-Ice Memories. The work outfit worn by Magallan to make shaved ice during the food festival combines traditions of Higashi with characteristics of Rhine Labs. Breathable, well-insulated, and easy to move in, this outfit allows Magallan to fully devote herself to her work, even if in a shaved-ice shop.
skins.quote: After replacing manual labor with technology, Magallan discovered a new side to frosty confection-making.
